documents.rights_basis: English translations actually printed in the identified 1907 United States periodical are public domain in the United States. This derivative changes only declared running matter and whitespace; it supplies no new translation or corrected words.
documents.rights_notice: Historical English wording is public domain in the United States; modern host wrappers and project-created apparatus retain separate rights.
documents.source_note: Historical English translation in The American Catholic Quarterly Review 32 (1907), pp. 705–730. Translator unrecorded. The historical English printing has a substantive duplicated/substituted line and broken continuation on printed page 705. Native image inspection confirms a printing defect, rather than an extraction failure; no missing words are supplied. The entire damaged printed extent, all three parts, seven remedial sections, closing and signature are retained. Severe inherited OCR errors also remain, especially near printed pages 726 and 728. This is not a complete-act reading, corrected text or full image-collated edition.
